   dereference it.

   1. Test g_pLuxBattleCurrentWorldMode.

   active-session/round-result state and must be restored or replayed at its original frame phase.

{

    (g_pLuxBattleActiveSessionData->roundResultCinematicState).nCleanupFrameCounter = 1;
  }
  return;
}
